coverage.summary: Covers landlords of residential rental property in the City of San Diego. No unit-count, construction-date, owner-type or landlord-size limits are stated.
coverage.other_conditions: The terms landlord, lease, residential rental property and tenant take their definitions from S.D. Mun. Code § 98.0702. Residential rental property there means any dwelling or unit intended for human habitation, including any dwelling or unit in a mobilehome park.

result.notes: The summary no longer covers the prohibition on selling or licensing devices, because that is conduct rather than coverage. The draft ordinance borrows only the § 98.0702 definitions. It does not adopt the Division 7 exemptions in § 98.0703, which cover new construction within 15 years of certificate of occupancy, owner-occupied, affordable-housing and similar properties. Those exemptions therefore were not added as coverage limits. The affordable-housing carve-out in the 'algorithmic device' definition limits what software counts as a device, not which properties are covered, so it stays under exemptions rather than coverage. DX05 is the same document as D076.
